messages:
Amir (PM): quick thread to assign the PM-412 postmortem actions. want owners + jira links so we can track for the remediation sprint. can people claim?

Lee (SRE): happy to own the autoscale regression fix. will open a ticket and add steps to repro and a test plan. target week-of 4/6.

Rosa (Eng-Platform): I'll take the deploy validation hook and CI check. will split into two tickets: infra change + CI tests.

Ken (Oncall): can own the runbook updates and the on-call training item. suggest a checklist and a 45m hands-on session.

Amir (PM): great. can we include RACI for each ticket and set due dates aligned with sprint end 4/12? also please add acceptance criteria so we can close later.

Lee (SRE): created ticket POST-6401 for autoscale fix. description includes: reproduce steps, perf fixture, expected vs observed, and rollback plan. assignee=Lee, due=2026-04-12. RACI: R=Lee, A=Rosa, C=Ken, I=Amir. linking to PM-412.

Rosa (Eng-Platform): created POST-6402 (deploy hook) and POST-6403 (CI tests). POST-6402 assigned to Rosa, due 2026-04-09. POST-6403 assigned to QA, due 2026-04-12. RACI noted in each ticket.

Ken (Oncall): created RUN-221 for runbook edits and TRAIN-55 for the on-call session. RUN-221 assignee=Ken, due 2026-04-05. TRAIN-55 assignee=Ken, scheduled 2026-04-08 11:00am. Adding checklist: steps to escalate, clear repro playbook, and post-incident communication template.

JiraBot: POST-6401 linked to PM-412, labels=[postmortem, remediation], status=Open.

Amir (PM): nice. two follow-ups: (1) let's add a recurring incident pattern item to analyze rate of similar failures over last 6 months. who can take that? (2) ensure acceptance tests run in the canary pipeline.

Lee (SRE): I can run the pattern analysis but will need data access from metrics team. will create subtask POST-6401-1 and tag metrics. ETA 4/9.

Rosa (Eng-Platform): I'll wire the acceptance tests into canary flow for POST-6403. will add rollback gating too.

Ken (Oncall): please include a blunt "if X happens, rollback immediately" line in the runbook. made that change in RUN-221.

Amir (PM): great. final ask: update the postmortem doc with ticket links, RACI table, and expected close dates. I'll check Friday and then send the remediation sprint kickoff invite.

Lee (SRE): updated PM-412 doc with links + RACI table. added acceptance criteria for POST-6401: repro, test, and monitored canary for 48h.

Rosa (Eng-Platform): tied POST-6403 to canary pipeline. added test matrix and performance thresholds.

JiraBot: POST-6402 updated: assignee=Rosa, due=2026-04-09, labels=[infra, postmortem].

Amir (PM): thanks everyone. closing thread for now  reopen if tickets slip or data shows recurrence. :white_check_mark:
